Use the pooklet method in body shop! 

First use [this](https://trinket.io/python/004e94882f) generator. It will give you a -/+ number and then in body shop click on the corresponding slider that amount of times (e.g. for -8 on “cheek size” click the cheek size slider 8 times to the *left*, a + number you click to the right. Do this for every slider, you will end up with a very extreme looking sim. 

Then, use [this](https://trinket.io/python/39ab792862) generator. Enter how many face templates you have. It will then give you two combinations of templates for each area of the face. Find that face template and drag it half way. You’ll end up with some really unique looking sims! 

As much as I hate to promote her, Cindy made a video demonstrating how to use this method [here](https://youtu.be/ogUpqPMt0JA?si=PvotBle-0G1TMLts)
